text_block_list.text:
Many fans whose hearts were stolen by her at the Osaka Hai
had come to cheer her on.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Agnes Tachyon is running in today's race!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
I think I might've heard that name before.
Who was it again?

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
What a weird Umamusume!
Still, you can't help but be drawn into watching her.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Well, well, looks like quite a few
'fans' have shown up today."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Yes. This is a fine opportunity to investigate
the significance of cheers from others.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
The grand stage of a GⅠ race, and the cheers of the "fans"!
Everything is falling into place! Heh-heh-heh!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I wonder how far I can go today...
I'm itching to find out...!
